levels.elevation_source: median atlas height of the boarding edges on this level (LN02 assumed)

metadata.level_convention: OSM level numbers: 0 = street/main platform level, negative = below
metadata.heights: metres above sea level, LN02 (atlas heights assumed LN02; terrain from swissALTI3D)
metadata.crs: EPSG:4326 (lon, lat); LV95 kept as properties where the source has it
metadata.licence: mixed per feature (see 'licence'); OSM-derived features are ODbL

properties.atlas_height_note: atlas 'height', metres above sea level as published (LN02 assumed)
properties.mode_guess_how: station modes from atlas; tram if an OSM tram track runs within 7 m of the atlas point
properties.platform_side_how: towards the centroid of the matched OSM platform polygon
properties.inferred_how: kerb line = long side of the OSM platform polygon nearest to the atlas point; polygon matched to the atlas edge by proximity and equal ref letter

verified_against.match: same station number and kerb letter

properties.terrain_height_source: swisstopo height service (swissALTI3D DTM, LN02); terrain, not structure
properties.walk_graph_node_how: nearest walk-graph node on the same level (inferred link, not a surveyed access)
